name: Can I choose a new color or texture during stucco resurfacing?
description: Yes, stucco resurfacing allows you to choose a new color and texture for your home's exterior.

mainEntity.name: Can I choose a new color or texture during stucco resurfacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, one of the significant advantages of stucco resurfacing is the opportunity to update your home's aesthetic. You can select from a wide range of colors and textures for the new topcoat. This allows you to completely transform the look of your property, giving it a modern refresh or matching a specific architectural style. Our team can help you explore various options to find the perfect finish that complements your home.
